{{Quote|Since then, Master Corin Tok has aged into a hardened warhorse; his myth has grown. He now stands between us and control of Axial Park.|General Hesker on Corin Tok|<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />}}
'''Corin Tok''', known as the '''"Sith Butcher"''' by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and '''Verda Jédii''' by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] renowned for his fortitude. His most famous acts were during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the [[Battle of Corellia]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Survivors claimed he was invincible. Blaster bolts splashing off skin, lightsabers failing in his presence. I say it's that special armor under his robes.|General Hesker|<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />}}
At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Master Corin Tok was an aged, and battle-hardened, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. He had earned his stripes during the [[Great Galactic War]], primarily during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. One of the few Jedi to survive that day, many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fell to his blade and a myth began to surround him. He was apparently able to shrug off [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire as if it were nothing, with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] failing in his presence. Although these were due to [[Armor/Legends|reinforced armor]] and [[cortosis-weave]]s, Imperial troops throughout the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] knew of and feared the Jedi.<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />

This reputation carried him to the [[Battle of Corellia]], where he stood as the Republic's last hope in holding [[Axial Park]]. Keeping the Imperials at bay, he drew the attention of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hesker]], the Imperial commander of the area, who sent a strike team in to eliminate him. Although he refused to go without a fight, he would ultimately fall before the Imperial forces, damaging Republic morale. In his last moments, he asked his killers to spare the lives of the wounded he was protecting.<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />

==Powers and abilities==
Corin was vastly skilled in lightsaber combat, as shown during the Sacking of Coruscant and the aforementioned Corellian Invasion.<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />

While he favored single saber combat and the [[Form III|Soresu]] form, he was also well-versed in [[Niman]], wielding two yellow-bladed lightsabers in tandem against his foes.<ref name="Sacking Gardens" />
